title: Concept: SOAP service description published
description: A WSDL document describing the service operations in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The description lists every operation, message shape and endpoint, which hands an attacker the full contract of a SOAP service including operations the app never calls.
applicability: Deployments that render a WSDL document describing the service operations into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The description lists every operation, message shape and endpoint, which hands an attacker the full contract of a SOAP service including operations the app never calls.
